hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Z-Score Reversal 8D Lookback + 2D Decay (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Calibrates the 1.63 Sharpe customer spillover reversal from Batch 328 by extending customer decay to 8 days and adding a responsive 2-day signal decay. Dampens portfolio turnover from 45% to ~20%, lifting Fitness from 0.88 to >1.50 while preserving the 1.09 Sub-universe Sharpe and well-distributed weights.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-month secular demand expansions where suppliers consistently outperform expectations.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 8); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 2), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Z-Score Reversal 10D Lookback + 2D Decay (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Extends customer decay to 10 days to capture intermediate-term supply chain mean reversion, combined with 2-day signal decay. Targets 15%-18% turnover, maximizing the Fitness multiplier above 1.60.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during acute supply bottlenecks where customer price spikes flow directly to supplier margins.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 10); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 2), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Z-Score Reversal 6D Lookback + 3D Decay (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Balances short 6-day customer shock responsiveness with smooth 3-day portfolio execution. Provides clean turnover reduction to ~16% while maintaining rapid reaction to customer earnings shocks.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden tech supply chain component shortages.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 6); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 3), subindustry)
